data.name: PanelUpdateRunning
data.value: An update is already queued or running.

data.name: PanelUpdateUnavailable
data.value: The panel cannot start an update on this server right now.

data.name: PanelUpdateRefused
data.value: The update was refused before anything was changed. Run the update from the server's command line to see why.

data.name: PanelUpdateRolledBack
data.value: The update failed its health check and the panel returned to the previous version. The database was not restored.

data.name: PanelUpdateRollbackFailed
data.value: The update failed and the previous version did not become healthy either. Check the server from its command line.

data.name: PanelUpdateInterrupted
data.value: The update was interrupted after the new version was switched in. Check the server from its command line.

data.name: PanelUpdateNotStarted
data.value: The update never started: the server's update service did not pick up the request.

data.name: PanelUpdateOutcomeUnknown
data.value: The update ended without reporting its result. Check the version the panel runs now.
